title: True Splits
description: Port of truesplits from chattriggers 1.8.9 to fabric for latest versions
body:
# True Splits!
- Port of the popular TrueSplits chattriggers module from 1.8.9.
- Tracks RTA and server tick time in run to show deviations due to lag.
- Tracks segments of both the clear and boss fight in f/m7.
- Integrated as an odin addon for ease of use.
